class: Any step that accepts, from its caller, the result of a check it depends on (a gate verdict, an 'active' version, an integrity hash computed by the caller) instead of running the check or reading the owning object itself can be bypassed by passing a forged or mismatched result; the check then protects nothing.
mechanism: Public functions took a SafetyResult / Version / legs-hash argument and trusted it: W-027 execute_confirmed_modification checked only `.blocked` on a caller-built SafetyResult; W-020 from_evaluation recorded a caller-passed Version as active; W-014 accepted a legs hash the caller computed over its own legs.

first_seen.evidence: final verifier: exit of 650 units against a fake 'SELL 650' position with a self-computed hash -> blocked=False

fix: Per instance: W-020 reads versions from the exact StrategyRecord type; W-027 calls check_pre_execution itself with inputs grounded from the record (no public verdict parameter); W-014 residual in deferred #29 item 5 (integration must read legs from the store). Mechanism: builder brief quality-bar line 'Never trust a caller-supplied verdict or identity' with a required forged-result test. W-026 (PR #44): the broker sink re-derives symbol, side, quantity, strategy and version from the bound record and catalogue; no public route except submit_confirmed; runtime public-API walk test.

checks: tests/execution/test_strategy_only.py (runtime public-API walk, send path only)
detection.note: The W-026 public-API walk guards the send path only; other gate-dependent modules still rely on the builder brief line and per-item forged-input tests.

occurrences.evidence: proposed v2 passed as active; then a StrategyRecord subclass overriding active_version

direct Preparation + public guard.issue(binding, None, None, 0, 0) sent a naked SELL 325 NIFTY 23400CE and a BANKNIFTY buy; then public mint_capability sent a sell for a non-existent strategy and a forged plan reached the broker; fixed by a private sink that re-derives every broker field (PR #44)
